records.question: 不同会员等级的客户贡献了多少销售额
records.generated_sql:

FROM dim_customer c

records.question: 各省份的订单数量分别是多少

records.question: 华东地区各商品类别的销售额是多少

records.question: 2025年各大区黄金会员的销售额
records.generated_sql:
SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, SUM(o.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.member_level = '黄金'
  AND o.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
GROUP BY r.region_name;

records.question: 每个季度不同品牌的销量
records.generated_sql:
SELECT d.quarter, p.brand, SUM(f.order_quantity) AS sales_volume
FROM fact_order f

JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
GROUP BY d.quarter, p.brand
ORDER BY d.quarter, p.brand;

records.question: 男性客户在各个省份的订单金额

records.question: 各年份各类别商品的销售总额
records.generated_sql:
